statement: No peer input can halt a Runtime: malformed, stale or racing input is refused, and only a broken local invariant halts.

layers.contract: n/a: what a Runtime does with a peer input is off-chain; the chain halts nothing of the Runtime
layers.rig: owed: test rig (a walk predicate for this rule; none is named yet)

killers.name: R-X1 no peer input halts the Runtime: strangers, stale acks and repeats are refused in place
R-X1 an input for an Entity this Runtime does not host is refused with notice, as a row
R-X1 a message from a stranger is refused with notice and changes nothing
R-DURABLE R-X1 in every world: no halt, no leak, every WAL replays, equal heads mean equal states
R-X1 a row refused for an Entity the Runtime does not host asks nothing of the chain
